title: CPL 2026 Squads Confirmed: Full Team Lists for All Seven Franchises
description: See the confirmed CPL 2026 squads for all seven teams, including international signings, Caribbean stars and each franchise's complete player list.
dek: Defending champions Trinbago Knight Riders lead a seven-team field that includes the new Jamaica Kingsmen, with the season running from 7 August to 20 September.
image_alt: Saint Lucia Kings players celebrate a wicket during the 2025 CPL playoffs
key_points: All seven franchises have confirmed 17-player squads for the 2026 Caribbean Premier League.
Trinbago Knight Riders return as defending champions, while Jamaica Kingsmen enter the competition for the first time.
The tournament begins on 7 August and concludes with the final at Kensington Oval on 20 September.

sections.heading: CPL 2026 squads are complete
paragraphs: The seven Republic Bank Caribbean Premier League franchises have confirmed their full squads for 2026. Each team has named 17 players, combining established Caribbean performers with overseas internationals and emerging regional talent.

Trinbago Knight Riders will defend the title with a familiar senior group, Jamaica Kingsmen will make their CPL debut, and Barbados Tridents will try to reach a home final at Kensington Oval. Supporters can also compare every roster in the CPL 2026 squad hub.

sections.heading: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons squad
paragraphs: The Falcons have built around Evin Lewis, Fabian Allen and returning Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph. Moeen Ali, Shadab Khan and Kusal Perera add international experience, while Jayden Seales strengthens a pace group that also contains Shamar Springer and Anderson Phillip. Visit the Antigua & Barbuda Falcons team page for player profiles and fixtures.

sections.heading: Barbados Tridents squad
paragraphs: Barbados have added proven T20 quality around Quinton de Kock, Brandon King and Sherfane Rutherford. Chris Green, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, George Linde and Daniel Sams give the Tridents several bowling combinations for a campaign that ends on home soil. See the Barbados Tridents team page.

sections.heading: Guyana Amazon Warriors squad
paragraphs: Imran Tahir will again lead a Warriors group featuring Shai Hope, Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd and Shamar Joseph. Glenn Phillips, Muhammad Nabi, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Dwaine Pretorius give Guyana experience across the batting and bowling units. See the Guyana Amazon Warriors team page.

sections.heading: Jamaica Kingsmen squad
paragraphs: Jamaica Kingsmen enter their first CPL season with Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith at the heart of the local group. Saim Ayub, Usman Khan, Hassan Khan, Maaz Sadaqat and Hunain Shah bring further depth to a squad designed to compete immediately. See the Jamaica Kingsmen team page.

sections.heading: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots squad
paragraphs: Johnson Charles and Andre Fletcher give the Patriots an experienced opening pair, with Jason Holder and Kyle Mayers supplying all-round quality. Naseem Shah brings high pace, while Wanindu Hasaranga and Waqar Salamkheil provide two attacking wrist-spin options. See the St Kitts & Nevis Patriots team page.

sections.heading: Saint Lucia Kings squad
paragraphs: Roston Chase anchors a balanced Kings squad alongside Ackeem Auguste, Jewel Andrew and Charith Asalanka. Noor Ahmad and Maheesh Theekshana headline the spin attack, with Matthew Forde and McKenny Clarke among the pace options. See the Saint Lucia Kings team page.

sections.heading: Trinbago Knight Riders squad
paragraphs: The defending champions retain Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard, Sunil Narine and Akeal Hosein. Alex Hales, Colin Munro and Usman Tariq return, while Justin Greaves, Matthew Breetzke and Amshi de Silva add fresh options as TKR chase a sixth CPL title. See the Trinbago Knight Riders team page.

sections.heading: When does CPL 2026 start?
paragraphs: CPL 2026 runs from 7 August to 20 September. Jamaica Kingsmen face Antigua & Barbuda Falcons in the opening match at Arnos Vale Stadium, while Kensington Oval hosts the playoffs and final.

The complete CPL 2026 schedule lists all 39 matches with venue-local start times and links to each match centre. Squad selections can still be affected by availability, injury or officially announced replacement players during the season.
